task.instruction: Write an instrument-platform recommendation for the next observing season. Choose between the reconfigurable and integrated arrays and define the evidence or failure condition that would reopen the choice.
hardConstraints: Use only claims supported by the supplied documents and prior records.
Cite the decision evidence with [doc-03] and [doc-01].
The selected platform must cover the two approved spectral bands and begin commissioning by 15 October.
Separate observed facts, interpretation, and recommendation.

documents.title: Capital award conditions
documents.content: The award funds either complete platform, not a mixed installation. It permits a documented replacement decision after the first season.

documents.title: Observing-season commissioning window
documents.content: Commissioning occupies 15 October through 10 November. Missing the start defers the approved program by one year.

documents.title: Array bench comparison
documents.content: Integrated array I improves sensitivity by 18% and covers both bands. Reconfigurable array R covers both bands at current sensitivity and can replace detector modules independently.

documents.title: Public tour route
documents.content: The east dome tour route changes during roof work. Research access uses the west entrance and is unaffected.

documents.title: Five-year maintenance scenarios
documents.content: I has one vendor service path with 96-hour response. R can use two suppliers but requires 14 additional calibration nights over five years.

target_a.content:
Situation: A housing cooperative is replacing its shared laundry equipment.
Shared facts [history-02-01-fact]: Leasing costs 14% more over three years but permits annual replacement; purchasing secures a 19% discount and fixes the model for seven years.
Decision: Lease for one year and collect repair and usage data before purchasing.
Reasoning: The disagreement concerns the value of retaining an exit relative to the coordination benefit of one fleet.

Situation: A university archive is selecting a file format for a digitization program.
Shared facts [history-02-02-fact]: The open format has broad tool support but larger storage cost; the optimized format cuts storage by 28% and depends on one maintained decoder.
Message excerpt: Store preservation masters in the open format and test the optimized format for access copies.

Situation: A small manufacturer is deciding between modular and integrated packaging lines.
Shared facts [history-02-03-fact]: The modular line can swap stations and produces 11% fewer units; the integrated line meets forecast demand with a five-year service contract.
Retrospective: Install the modular line until the product mix stabilizes.

Situation: A community theater is choosing rehearsal space for the next two years.
Shared facts [history-02-04-fact]: Monthly rentals preserve scheduling flexibility; a two-year lease lowers cost by 22% and enables permanent accessibility improvements.
log.decision=Rent for the first season and retain the ability to move after audience-access data arrives.

Situation: A research team is selecting a transcription vendor for sensitive interviews.
Shared facts [history-02-05-fact]: One vendor offers cancellable monthly service; the other offers a dedicated trained team only with a twelve-month minimum.
Decision: Use the monthly vendor for the pilot and keep the corpus portable.

Situation: A bridge inspection finds a crack above the mandatory closure threshold.
Shared facts [history-02-06-fact]: Two independent engineers confirm the measurement and the transport code requires immediate closure.
Message excerpt: Close the bridge and begin the prescribed structural assessment.

Situation: A clinic's vaccine refrigerator loses temperature control.
Shared facts [history-02-07-fact]: The excursion exceeds the manufacturer limit and the affected doses cannot be verified as viable.
Retrospective: Quarantine the doses and follow the replacement protocol.

Situation: A publisher is choosing an audiobook narrator for a series.
Shared facts [history-02-08-fact]: A rotating cast preserves future options; one narrator offers continuity and a lower per-book rate but has limited availability next year.
log.decision=Contract one title and keep later casting open until listener and schedule evidence is available.
